summary: postinstall exfiltrates AWS ECS task metadata to hardcoded ngrok endpoint
details: package.json declares a postinstall lifecycle script that runs automatically on npm install. The script uses node -e to fetch the AWS ECS container metadata endpoint (ECS_CONTAINER_METADATA_URI_V4/task), collecting the AWS account ID (derived from the TaskARN), ECS cluster name, task ARN, and container image inventory, then pipes the resulting JSON to curl -X POST against the hardcoded tunnel https://mourner-slot-explicit.ngrok-free.dev. The destination is an ngrok tunnel unrelated to any legitimate publisher infrastructure, and the collected data identifies the installer's cloud account and workload topology.
